research_findings: Identified unhandled 'Missing Description' warnings in Dialog components (`FeedbackModal.tsx`) when running tests, caused by omitting `DialogDescription` which is required for accessibility.

Identified 'An update to DiagramCanvas inside a test was not wrapped in act(...)' warnings in `DiagramCanvas.test.tsx` caused by asynchronous state updates driven by `vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync` not being wrapped in `act()`.
features_improved: Improved the accessibility of `FeedbackModal.tsx` by adding a visually hidden `DialogDescription` to comply with Radix UI and shadcn/ui best practices.
Fixed test warnings in `DiagramCanvas.test.tsx` ensuring asynchronous Excalidraw interactions and state updates are correctly wrapped with `@testing-library/react`'s `act()` function.
next_steps_for_next_run: Investigate `pnpm test run` outputs for any remaining test warnings (such as the db intro loading warning or missing act wrappers in other components).
Look into streamlining local environment setup to prevent build/test failures on fresh checkouts when `.env` is absent.
